source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary: One time per battle, as the [Shooting phase](vsdata:core-rule/shooting-phase) of your opponent's turn begins, this model may call on its psychic familiar. Doing so adds 6″ to the reach of its Mind Control until the phase ends. Designer's note: mark this with a Psychic Familiar token beside the model and take the token away once the ability is used.

detail.designerNote: track with a Psychic Familiar token
